claim:
Let \(X=\ell_3-\ell_1\) be the real Day--James plane with
\[
\|(s,t)\|=
\begin{cases}
\bigl(|s|^3+|t|^3\bigr)^{1/3},&st\ge0,\\
|s|+|t|,&st<0.
\end{cases}
\]
For Birkhoff--James orthogonality \(x\perp_B y\), define
\[
g_\perp(X)=
\inf_{\substack{x,y\in S_X\\x\perp_B y}}
\max\{\|x-y\|,\|x+y\|\}.
\]
Then
\[
g_\perp(X)=
\left(1+\frac{3}{2^{4/3}}\right)^{1/3}
=
1.298726719564592\ldots .
\]
Equality is attained by
\[
x=(2^{-1/3},2^{-1/3}),
\qquad
y=(1/2,-1/2),
\]
and by their images under the norm symmetries.

correctness.rationale: The sphere is exhaustively split into same-sign cubic arcs, opposite-sign taxicab facets, and axes. Smooth strata have unique Birkhoff directions from their norming functionals; axes use the full norming-functional cone. A strict 4/3 bound removes noncompetitive regimes. On the remaining cubic branch, an exact derivative factorization proves monotone decrease to the diagonal. The balanced diagonal/taxicab pair attains the radical.
risks: The exponent-three derivative argument is not asserted for general p.
The symbolic checker validates algebraic identities; the global inequality proof is in the written proof.
